claim: The GitHub repository page contains publicly accessible project and AI-engineering information.
evidence_text:
AI engineer guide is a comprehensive resource for going from software engineer/non-software engineer to professional AI engineer. Whether you're a seasoned software engineer or venturing into the tech world from a different discipline, our resource is tailored to help you navigate the exciting journey to becoming a professional AI Engineer.
This Edition 2 reflects the latest trends in AI engineering for 2025, including Agentic AI, Advanced RAG systems, Multimodal AI, and Enterprise AI deployment.
See [CONTRIBUTING.](https://github.com/athivvat/ai-engineer-guide/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md)
